mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ',') AS tags_text FROM post p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id
mapper.select: WHERE p.status = 'published' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.featured DESC, p.published_at DESC, p.created_at DESC
GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
WHERE p.slug = #{slug} AND p.status = 'published' GROUP BY p.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (title, slug, description, content_md, cover_url, category_id, author_name, status, featured, published_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{contentMd}, #{coverUrl}, #{categoryId}, #{authorName}, #{status}, #{featured}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'published' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, slug = #{slug}, description = #{description}, content_md = #{contentMd}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, category_id = #{categoryId}, author_name = #{authorName}, status = #{status}, featured = #{featured}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'published' AND published_at IS NULL THEN NOW() WHEN #{status} = 'published' THEN published_at ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO post_tag (post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
